description: This file defines the Activity controller class for the Opencart admin dashboard, handling display and saving of activity data, as well as rendering activity feed.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Controller class for managing dashboard activity display, saving settings, and rendering activity feed in Opencart admin.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the activity dashboard page with breadcrumbs, configuration options, and layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of dashboard activity settings, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Generates and returns the activity feed view with recent activities.
